I set punishment to maximum (10) for any return below 20 to strongly deter selfish behavior, and zero punishment for returns of 20 or above to reward cooperation. This makes it clearly in Agent_8's interest to return at least 20 to avoid a 25-coin penalty, while also making higher returns unpunished to encourage generosity.
